title: Joyful Granada food tour
text: A wonderful introduction to the cultural richness of Granada. Our guide, Laura, has so much knowledge of Granada and its multiple, interweaving cultural layers. And the best part was her incredibly joyful, engaging, enthusiastic personality. We felt an instant connection with Laura and were riveted by her passion for and knowledge of food and her exuberance about sharing with us. We had a wonderful tour and we highly recommend Laura!!
author: traceylasz
